newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Telebras to reveal '96 profit this week.
newsitem.headline: Telebras to reveal '96 profit this week.

text.p: Brazilian state-owned telecommunications firm Telebras is likely to announce its 1996 full-year results this week, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said on Tuesday.
Preliminary figures point to a 3.25 billion reais net profit for Telebras' holding, a result which is line with market's and government's expectations, the newspaper said.
Earlier this month Communications Minister Sergio Motta said Telebras posted a 3.2 billion reais profit in 1996, without specifying if he was referring to consolidated or the holding's profits.
No Telebras officials were immediately available for comment on the report.
In 1995, Telebras' holding posted a net profit of 1.18 billion reais, while the firm's consolidated net profit was 809 million reais, Gazeta said.
Telebras accounts for 70 percent on average of trade in the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa).
